supporting_observations.claim: At 13:40:29 UTC, the proxy logged a request from NWD\ivy.chen on WS-ICHEN-01 for https://raw.githubusercontent.com/nwd-it/tools/main/u.ps1, with status 200. A related CONNECT record shows traffic to raw.githubusercontent.com at the same time.
The request is temporally consistent with the reported PowerShell window, but the records do not tie it to a PowerShell process or establish that the script was executed.

The observed GitHub request does not match the listed workstation-patching workflow, which uses sam.okafor, WS-SOKAFOR-01, and \\FILE-NWD-01\Admin\Apply-Updates.ps1. The request alone does not establish whether u.ps1 had another legitimate purpose.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied records show the proxy request but do not include a corresponding PowerShell process-start, command-line, script-block, or script-content record for the reported time; execution and content therefore cannot be verified.
The proxy GET status and connection records do not establish who initiated the request or whether it was made by PowerShell.
claims_not_established: Whether u.ps1 was downloaded in full, what its contents or hash were, or whether it was executed.
Whether the PowerShell window Ivy reported was caused by this request or by another activity.
Whether Ivy had an authorized purpose for retrieving this script.
additional_evidence_needed: Retrieve the proxy response content or a reliable file hash for u.ps1 and assess its contents and provenance.

Collect endpoint process and PowerShell telemetry for WS-ICHEN-01 around 13:40 UTC, including process creation and command line, PowerShell operational/script-block logs, and AMSI or equivalent records.

unrelated_findings: A Dropbox updater process ran as SYSTEM on WS-ICHEN-01; Dropbox is not among the listed approved services. This is separate from the alerted PowerShell activity. (T033-00210, T033-00211)
